text:
carol: Postmortem follow-up thread for streaming/chat reliability. We need owners, explicit done criteria, and CI gates for timeouts/partials/reconnect behavior. I'll track here.

ivan: I'll own the reconnect/backoff work on the service + SDK. Acceptance: staging deploy + SDK release with default reconnect cap of 1/min and configurable max_retries <=6. PR by 2027-05-09.

nate: I'll take partial-detection and close-codes. Plan: detect truncated final frames, emit metric streaming.partial_flag, and add close code 434 = partial_truncated. ETA 2027-05-12. I'll add an e2e that injects truncated frames.

polly: Observability owner here. Will add prefix-level trace propagation, ttfb.p50/p95 histograms, and sampled_payloads with regex redaction for secrets. Proposal: 7d retention, 2KB sample cap. Need security signoff. ETA 2027-05-08.

infra-bot: pattern-note: partial spikes correlated with scale-in events. Infra will provision a small warm worker pool for canary windows.

carol: CI gating: any PR touching streaming path must include a short PR benchmark that asserts median TTFB regression <= 7% vs baseline. Is that doable?

ivan: Yes. I'll add a PR job that runs a 3-minute synthetic and compares against stored baseline. Pseudocode posted in the PR.

nate: For protocol docs: I'll add a section with the new close codes and guidance on client reconnect behavior (backoff + resumable token). Suggested close codes: 400, 410, 434, 450 (server_overloaded).

polly: On metrics, I'll add a label 'reconnect_cause' with values client|server|network and a slice 'partial_trigger' with values cold_start|kv_miss|encode_error.

carol: Canary plan: ops to run a 48h canary in staging after staging merges. Canary should include reconnect floods, cold-start patterns, and an autoscaler downscale simulation. Ops, can you schedule?

ops-bot: Canary job "stream-stability-check" scheduled for staging 2027-05-16 01:00 UTC for 48h. Ramp + spike phases included. Results posted to #eng-sre.

ivan: One implementation note: I'll emit a reconnect_hint header and support resumable tokens so clients can continue instead of creating duplicate sessions. Sample config I'll include: ```
streaming:
  reconnect:
    enabled: true
    max_retries: 6
    base_delay_ms: 250
    max_delay_ms: 45000
    jitter: full
    resumable_tokens: true
```

nate: e2e test plan: inject truncated final frame, assert metric increment and close code 434, assert session marked for warm-restart.

polly: Security ask: need approval for sampled payload retention 7d and redaction regex. I'll open the ticket today.

carol: Owners and dates recap: ivan -> reconnect PR 2027-05-09, nate -> partial-detect PR 2027-05-12, polly -> observability PR 2027-05-08, infra warm pool -> 2027-05-10, canary -> 2027-05-16 to 2027-05-18. I'll maintain the tracker doc with PR links.

ivan: I'll also add an SDK quick patch to cap aggressive reconnects noted in the incident (some clients reopened every 2s). Default 1/min, configurable.

infra-bot: note: autoscaler tweak for canary: hold scale-in for 3 minutes when reconnect flood detected.

carol: Blocker check: anyone blocked on approvals or infra?

polly: Waiting on security signoff for sampled payloads. Ticket created.

ivan: No infra blockers for reconnect changes.

nate: No blockers. Will start tests tomorrow.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync Mon 2027-05-10 15:00 UTC in #incidents.

carol: Thanks team. I'll post the tracker with links and update this thread when PRs land. Next sync Mon 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
